ABOUT US
settings.text:
Agent Issues is an independent print magazine of everyday obsessions, based in Paris.
Each issue follows one ordinary subject through our Agents inside fashion, art, music and games, who report back from where they stand.
We’re open to collaborations, commissions and long emails, so if you feel you’re an Agent, [write to us](mailto:agentissuesparis@gmail.com?subject=Inquiry%20/%20Agent%20Issues).
